def test_jobs_due_together_run_in_insertion_order(clock):
    s = Scheduler(clock)
    s.call_later(1, "second-job", lambda: "b")
    s.call_later(1, "first-job", lambda: "a")
    clock.advance(1)
    assert s.run_due() == ["b", "a"]

def test_advance_accepts_timedelta(clock):
    from datetime import timedelta

    clock.advance(timedelta(seconds=90))
    assert clock.now() == 1_090.0
